texts: In malignant mesothelioma, invasion of a rib makes the tumour unresectable: E is the answer.
Involvement of the visceral pleura, the diaphragm, the pericardium, or a single focus in the soft tissue of the chest wall can still be removed, with reconstruction where needed.
Diffuse or multifocal invasion of the chest wall, of bone, or of the mediastinal organs means the disease cannot be resected.
Memory hook: Franky peels the rind off the sack, the floor and the purse, but when the crab bites the rib, Zoro lowers his sword.
